coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required controls and the specified logarithmic inference-time measure are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100 80GB SXM4 or H100 rather than NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, and generally three repetitions rather than ten per task. Fixed random seeds are not specified; deterministic decoding is not equivalent. The shared prompting-framework installation and BoT repository configuration are not established. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits the finding that BoT generally increases inference time compared with single-query methods and the supplied task-specific logarithmic timings, including BoT being faster than PAL on Game of 24.
